description: Requires a JWT from a signed-in session (never a connected app or an rk_ key). Sets where your creator-sale shares (80% of each sale) and affiliate credits (25% of a referred buyer's first Studio month) are paid: a Solana wallet's main base58 address (not a token account, never one of Rokha's own wallets). "" clears it. Needs a claimed page (page_claim) — the address attaches to it. Changing an existing address pauses sends for 10 minutes. Rokha runs no other payouts. To be paid on an EVM chain instead, pass `evm_address` (0x…) with `chain` (base | ethereum | robinhood) and optionally `token` (Base: USDC · Ethereum: USDC or USDT · Robinhood Chain: USDG; the chain's default when omitted); `evm_address: ""` goes back to Solana. Your Solana address is never changed by an EVM call.

address.description: A Solana wallet address (base58), or "" to clear.

chain.description: With evm_address: the chain you are paid on (default base).

evm_address.description: Be paid on an EVM chain: your 0x wallet address, or "" to go back to Solana.

prefer.description: With evm_address: evm (default) or solana to keep the address on file but be paid in Solana USDC.

token.description: With evm_address: the stablecoin (default: USDC on Base/Ethereum, USDG on Robinhood Chain).

name: payout_wallet_set
title: Set your payout wallet
